thread:
marie_ae: Customer POC reporting slow TTFT on /chat since ~10:15 PDT. Dedicated pool 'merchant-dedicated', model redwood-small-13b (q4_0). Also intermittent 429s. cc @tony_se @kevin_sre

ton y_se: Can you paste a minimal repro and runtime lines?

customer_engineer: Repro: prompt ~60 tokens, expected ~400 tokens. First token at ~2s but completion takes 9-12s. App logs show occasional 'rate_limit:queue_full'. No client-side network issues.

kevin_sre: Runtime shows KV cache misses and prefetch=false in config. Snippet: "kvcache::miss prefetch=false" and limiter queued spikes -> queue_full 429s. That matches TTFT tail and 429s.

marie_ae: They set prefetch=false for compliance (no persistent KV). Is there a non-persistent warmup?

tony_se: Two approaches: ephemeral prefetch (in-memory only) or on-demand prefetch with TTL=0. Recommend ephemeral + short warmup script and modest bump to batch_size=4, concurrency=8 on pool. Example curl: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefetch -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-small-13b","prefixes":["<common_prefix>"],"mode":"ephemeral","ttl_ms":300000}'

kevin_sre: Also cap context to 1024 tokens to avoid kernel path changes. Enabling dynamic_chunking helps q4_0. Quick local checks: ephemeral prefetch cut tail by ~30% and TTFT from 2.1s -> 1.6s.

anita_cs: I'll add ephemeral prefetch wording to the security answers (no external persistence; stays in GPU process memory).

billing_bot: Ballpark: sustained 200 req/s with short burst buffer maps to a reserved tier quote. I'll post formal numbers in the deal doc.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: applying ephemeral prefetch config to merchant-dedicated pool (initiated by @kevin_sre).

customer_engineer: Legal asked: any write to external KV?

tony_se: No writes. Ephemeral stays in process. We can provide an audit log snippet showing no KVS writes.

marie_ae: Action items: 1) @tony_se provide warmup script + sample config, 2) @kevin_sre confirm q4_0 safe with dynamic_chunking, 3) @billing_bot provide formal quote for 200 rps sustained, 4) @anita_cs attach security note to SOW. Will update customer after warmup.

customer_engineer: We'll test warmup tonight and report. Thanks team.
